notes.title: Update #1 - Bugs Fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today I received a complain from one of the players who were experiencing issues related to "save game" feature and a few broken achievements.

On the same day, I just pushed an update for Jaxon The Thief game with the following fixes!

1. There was a broken achievement for the Level 6 which has been fixed successfully!

2. Someone told me that Level 14 was not automatically saving and I have fixed the issue. Actually, there was an issue with the save system for that particular level and the feature should now work as intended.

3. Fixed other minor bugs.

If you encounter further issues please feel free to let me know by commenting below or start discussion thread. I hope you will enjoy the game.

Thank you very much for your patience!

Best Regards,
Anamik
